_comment: Copy to monthly_build.local.json (git-ignored) and replace each <...> with this machine's path, writing every backslash twice. data_root holds one folder per delivery; mlrs_drop and nlsdb_drop are the shared folders the zips are uploaded to; conda_root/conda_env give the env with ogr2ogr (Parquet + GEOS) and fiona.
data_root: <folder that holds one folder per delivery>
mlrs_drop: <shared folder with the MLRS Full and MC zips>
